title: Austin Funds $500K for Home Repair Program
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation convened to address local housing issues.
*   They authorized up to $500,000 for a critical home repair program.
*   These funds will cover essential residential roofing and emergency home repairs for residents.
*   The initiative is supported by the city's General Obligation Bond funding.
